svg.title: PIR®, Psychedelics In Recovery™
svg.desc: The PIR® mark beside a night sky slowly breathing toward daybreak: layered violet, cyan and gold light, constellations drawing themselves in, a few stars drifting. A safe, sacred space to integrate and discuss the role of psychedelics in your recovery journey.
